changelogs.title: v0.1.15
bullets: Prompt text: "Open Recycler" / "Ouvrir Recycleur" instead of Search/Fouiller
Fix OUTPUT items vanishing when taken to inventory: loot-style per-slot UpdateSlot (no bulk rewrite), TE change listeners instead of polling refresh, pause scrap while dragging
Fix no OUTPUT while UI open: client owns scrap while accessing the TE (server writes were ignored); server scrap only when UI closed
Fix open sound delayed ~10s: play combine_station_open immediately with UI; open_time=0; stop Unlock on open (LockManager)
Fix scrap UI loop with no OUTPUT: client waits for server after countdown; server registers on UpdateSlot + SetModified right after finish
Fix scrap time: use vanilla formula (scales with output amount), then 1.10x speed — no more ~0.4s for big stacks
Fix MP: only server/host processes scrap (stops client+server double-speed and item vanish when taking OUTPUT)
Fix UI: don't refresh grids while dragging; unlock TE lock on close like vanilla loot; always SetModified on slot writes
Scrap like backpack: INPUT always finishes; yield goes to an unlimited pending queue, then drains into OUTPUT when there is space (40 / 400 / 10000 radiators OK)
Fix items that never finished scrap (timer loop): allow partial output + spill to other output slots when yield exceeds stack size
Fix queue blocked when paired OUTPUT still holds scrap: merge/spill into other OUTPUT slots so INPUT can keep recycling
Balance: scrap speed 1.10x vs backpack (faster than backpack again)
Fix timer stuck on 00:00: show real countdown (e.g. 7.2s), stop vanilla UpdateTimer overwrite
Fix scrap timers not showing on input slots (requires IsLocked + label text)
Fix Harmony crash on launch (wrong OpenLooting parameter name)
Dedicated UI with separate INPUT / OUTPUT slot groups
Timers on input slots while recycling
Fix display names FR **Recycleur** / EN **Recycler** (V3.1 localization columns)
Fix recycling: top-row queues now process into bottom-row outputs
New station block `perfectRecycler` (combine-station mesh, green tint `6ECF6E`)
Storage UI: 10 queue slots + 10 output slots
Parallel scrap: +50% yield, 2x speed vs backpack
Recipe: 150 nails, 100 polymer, 1 battery, 500 wood, 20 electric parts
